sources.entry: Lyricism - macOS app to show you lyric what currently iTunes or Spotify is playing.

summary.one_liner: Lyricism is a macOS app that displays the lyrics of the song currently playing in iTunes or Spotify.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Lyricism as a macOS app that shows the lyrics of whatever iTunes or Spotify is currently playing. It contains a short description and a placeholder for screenshots, but no detailed feature list. The README does not describe how lyrics are fetched, the interface, or configuration options. Details beyond the one-line description are not documented in the README.
use_cases: view lyrics while listening to music on a Mac
follow along with lyrics during Spotify playback
see lyrics for iTunes songs on macOS
notable: Shows lyrics for the track currently playing in iTunes or Spotify
caveats: README is very brief and gives no installation or usage instructions
Works only with iTunes or Spotify on macOS, as named in the description
